x: 1st October - Paris - FRANCE v G.BRITAIN v FINLAND Triple Jump 1.E.Battista (France) 51'7¼" 2.F.Alsop (GB) 51'4½" 3.K.Helminen (Fin) 50'11" 5.D.Boosey (GB/BEL) 49'5¾"
Britain has picked her strongest possible team for the match and Derek partners the man who led them all for four rounds in the Tokyo Olympics---Fred Alsop.
He partners Fred Alsop who was 4th at Tokyo in 1964. Another to tread that lonely Tartan strip will be our second-claim long-jumper Alan Lerwill, who is coached by our own Dave Ansell.
